parts.label: (a)
parts.text: Describe and explain how the density and melting point of cobalt compare to those of calcium.

parts.label: (b)
parts.text:
Transition metals can form complexes.

What is meant by the term *transition metal complex*?

parts.label: (c)(i)
parts.text:
Cobalt can form the compounds $[\text{Co}(\text{NH}_3)_5\text{Br}]\text{SO}_4$ and $[\text{Co}(\text{NH}_3)_5\text{SO}_4]\text{Br}$. These two compounds are structural isomers.

Define the term *structural isomer*.
